name: After § 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the political repression and humanitarian situation in Cuba
part_text: 1g. Recalls that any threat or use of force against Cuba would constitute a serious violation of the UN Charter and the principle of sovereignty; takes very seriously the increasingly aggressive rhetoric and signals from the Trump administration, including discussions in US policy circles about the possibility of military escalation and regime change; calls for the EU and its Member States to categorically reject any form of military intervention against Cuba;
